rules: Dedupe every candidate against the rest of this round's batch before submitting: 5 of 20 rejects (25%) were exact duplicates already proposed in this same run, the single largest rejection cause.

A window-only edit to an archived shape does not decorrelate even when the window is changed consistently everywhere it appears: a 15-vs-21-day swap in a bounded-position ratio scored rho 0.990, and a 5-vs-21-day swap in a rank-spread scored rho 0.992. Change the field or the combining structure, not a window value.

Price-only combinations with no fundamental leg are failing the cheap screen hard right now: all 5 cheap_screen rejects this round were pure price/return shapes (momentum, momentum times sign of momentum, open-deviation over range-sum, short return sums), including a near-miss at |t| 0.98.

TS_STD(field,63)/TS_STD(field,5) crossed with a delta of the same field is now a saturated chassis regardless of which field or window feeds the delta leg: a $close(21)-delta version still shared 10 nodes with the archived $open(5)-delta version.

Any ratio with denominator TS_MEAN($close,21)+eps is a closed subtree no matter the numerator or the outer term crossed with it: a $book_per_share numerator still shared 5 nodes with an archived $high-minus-$low version.
Long time-series windows (~252 days) fail coverage even on plain return/price fields, not only fundamentals: TS_CORR($return, DELAY($return,1), 252) landed at 0.873 coverage.

A single-day DELAY(1) lagged-range denominator accepted at 0.935 the same round a windowed-sum range denominator with an extra momentum multiplier failed cheap_screen: DELAY(1)-based denominators look like distinct, less-mined territory from TS_MEAN/TS_SUM/TS_MAX-TS_MIN range denominators.

A fundamental rank crossed with CS_RANK of negated short-window return volatility (not volume or range) produced the round's best fitness at 3.470: extend the fundamental times independent-price-leg pattern to TS_STD($return,5)-based legs, not just volume/range stats.
